description:
Post-MVP. Add a Linux implementation of the `Sandbox` trait (M3) so checks can run sandboxed on Linux. The MVP ships macOS-only (APFS `clonefile`) behind the `cfg`-gated trait. Linux CoW options to evaluate: btrfs/xfs reflink (`FICLONE` ioctl / `cp --reflink`) or overlayfs, with a copy fallback where reflinks aren't supported. Slots in as a new `Sandbox` impl + platform selection; no execution-phase changes expected.

———
